name: Boldogasszonyfa (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow blue horizontal stripe along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Boldogasszonyfa (a blue shield with a yellow tree and a crescent, with a green and yellow mantling and a scroll).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
